newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Alusuisse sets July 4 news conference.
newsitem.headline: Alusuisse sets July 4 news conference.

text.p: Aluminium, chemicals and packaging group Alusuisse-Lonza Holding AG called a news conference on July 4 to talk about "the further development of our strategy".
The company was not more specific in an invitation to the media and no spokesman was immediately available to comment.
New chief executive officer Sergio Marchionne, who took office in April, pledged at the time to continue to focus on Alusuisse's three core businesses of aluminium, chemicals and packaging.
